newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Ibex-35 rises to new closing high 6,675.46.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Ibex-35 rises to new closing high 6,675.46.

text.p: Spain's Ibex-35 index of leading shares gained 1.42 percent to close at a new high of 6,675.46 pesetas on Tuesday.
The Ibex-35 reached 6,703.80 pesetas during the trading session after opening at 6,647.96.
The previous record closing high was set on Monday when the Ibex-35 hit 6,592.01.
The general index also ended at a fresh closing high, gaining 7.03 points, 1.23 percent, to 577.76.
This latest in a record-breaking series was supported in particular by strength in Telefonica, Gas Natural and banks BBV and Santander.
But in general dealers say shares are in a free rise as investors seek more profitable alternatives to traditional savings instruments since interest rates have fallen to historic lows.
